Name: TimeChangerMod ENG VERSION
Author: Ministerstwo
Description:
A simple and convenient utility mod for Stardew Valley 1.6+, designed specifically for single-player use. If you're tired of waiting for evening to come, want to quickly skip the day to a specific hour, or need to test other mods at different times of day — this mod does it all in one click.

How it works:
Time control is done by holding Ctrl (both left and right Ctrl work) together with the function keys F1 — F10:

    Ctrl + F1 — set time to 13:00
    Ctrl + F2 — set time to 14:00
    Ctrl + F3 — set time to 15:00
    Ctrl + F4 — set time to 16:00
    Ctrl + F5 — set time to 17:00
    Ctrl + F6 — set time to 18:00
    Ctrl + F7 — set time to 19:00
    Ctrl + F8 — set time to 20:00
    Ctrl + F9 — set time to 21:00
    Ctrl + F10 — set time to 22:00

When the switch is successful, a neat and clear text notification appears at the top of the screen (for example: "Time changed to 15:00").
